Preserve the exact tight three-quarter running composition, athletic body, original hands firmly holding the single red AFL ball, grassy oval, stadium and background. Keep the main player's selected team guernsey consistent. A focused, natural expression; no exaggerated grimace. No tackle, no kick, no new foreground players. SCENE 2 — PRE-KICK RUN START IMAGE. CRITICAL: DIRECT REPLACEMENT OF THE ORIGINAL MASTER FOOTBALLER'S FACE with the CUSTOMER'S EXACT SELFIE IDENTITY. Do not leave the master player's original face largely unchanged, retain its distinctive features, or merely generate a similar-looking footballer. The SELFIE face is the sole identity reference and OVERRIDES the master face. Transfer the actual identifiable eye shape and spacing, brows, nose, mouth and lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, forehead, hairline and hair texture, skin detail and apparent age. Blend face, ears and neck perfectly into the existing floodlit lighting and exposed skin, with matching tone and shadows; no face-mask look or different-colour neck. KEEP THE MASTER'S EXACT FULL-BODY FORWARD-RUNNING COMPOSITION: football held at chest height in BOTH hands, preparing to kick but NOT YET kicking. Do not move, drop or duplicate the ball. Preserve the player's athletic pose, camera angle, oval, packed nighttime stadium and the single trailing defender. The central player wears the selected team guernsey. The chasing defender is ESSENDON BOMBERS: BLACK GUERNSEY WITH A BOLD RED DIAGONAL SASH; every other visible opponent must match that same uniform. Do not change the defender's face, add a tackle, add new goalposts to the opening image, introduce new people or alter the original scene geography. The result must unmistakably show the selfie person, not the master-image athlete. CRITICAL: Transfer the selfie person's COMPLETE hairstyle, part, hair length, hairline, crown, sides and hair colour as well as the face. CHOSEN TEAM OVERRIDES MASTER CLOTHING: completely replace the central player's original master guernsey with the selected team's exact colour arrangement and stripe orientation; don't leave Collingwood-style vertical black-and-white stripes when another team is selected.

SCENE 3 — PREMIERS CELEBRATION START IMAGE. The central footballer must have the customer's ACTUAL SELFIE FACE with the same recognisable eyes, nose, mouth proportions, cheeks, jawline, chin, forehead, hairline, skin texture and apparent age. Do not replace the selfie with a generic heroic player or retain the master face. Preserve the existing raised-fists celebration pose, surrounding teammates' individual faces, hands, grips, positions, stadium and night lighting, BUT NOT their original source-team guernseys. The original master shows an extreme wide-open-mouth shout; if that alters the customer's facial identity, use a natural happy smile or slightly open triumphant mouth while preserving excitement through the arms, body and teammates. CRITICAL SEAMLESS SKIN BLENDING: face, ears, jaw, neck and exposed upper chest must look like ONE real person in ONE photograph, with matching skin tone, undertone, texture, brightness and floodlight shadows. No pasted-on face, face/neck colour split, altered jaw colour, hard edges or mismatched tan. MANDATORY TEAM-COLOUR REPLACEMENT: RE-DRESS the central player AND EVERY visible celebrating teammate in the selected team's guernsey style as specified by the selected playing guernsey style above. The source master has Collingwood-style black-and-white vertical stripes; remove those source-team strips completely when the customer selects any other team. Apply the exact selected team colours, pattern and stripe orientation to EVERY winning player without exception; never inherit the original master's black-and-white vertical stripes unless that is genuinely the selected team's specified kit. Correct every visible jersey, including portions obscured by hands and teammates. Do not preserve the master's old chest design or sponsors. All celebrating teammates and the central player wear consistent matching guernseys for the selected team. Preserve the existing players and their distinct identities; no opposition players, no extra teammates and no new faces. CRITICAL: The central player's hair MUST be replaced completely with the hairstyle visible in the selfie, from hairline to crown and both sides. Do not keep ANY of the master player's curly, voluminous or differently coloured hair. Preserve the actual selfie's cut, length, direction, part and hair colour, whatever the customer's hair colour is, even while celebrating.

sharedPrompt: Photorealistic Australian rules football PHOTOGRAPHIC IMAGE EDIT, not new character generation. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the MASTER COMPOSITION: preserve the original footballer's body, pose, hands, ball, camera angle, stadium, grass, background players, night floodlights and realistic lighting. INPUT IMAGE 2 is the CUSTOMER'S ORIGINAL SELFIE and the DEFINITIVE, ONLY facial identity source for the central athlete. This is a strict photographic FACE REPLACEMENT, NOT creation of a similar-looking player. The central footballer must look like the ACTUAL PERSON in Image 2 rather than retaining Image 1's original face. Whenever the two faces conflict, the SELFIE FACE WINS.  CRITICAL FULL HEAD REPLACEMENT: the hairstyle, hair LENGTH, CUT, PARTING, DIRECTION, DENSITY, COLOUR, TEXTURE, TEMPLE SHAPE, HAIRLINE and SIDE/BACK HAIR must all come from Image 2 (SELFIE), NEVER from the master athlete in Image 1. Remove the master's original hair entirely, including curly, long, voluminous or differently coloured hair, and replace it with the customer's actual selfie hairstyle. Do not retain the master athlete's hairstyle while transferring only the face. Maintain the selfie hairstyle consistently from forehead through crown, sides and back, adapting only camera perspective and natural floodlight illumination. Match the actual customer's hair precisely, regardless of its colour, length or texture; never assume the customer has dark, straight or short hair. Match ears and neck skin seamlessly to the selfie face. Preserve the customer's distinctive eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips and mouth proportions, cheek structure, jawline, chin, forehead, hairline, hair texture/colour, skin texture and apparent age. Do not retain the original model face, create a lookalike, beautify, age, masculinise, idealise, slim, exaggerate, stylise, smooth or invent new features. Adapt only head angle, subtle natural expression and illumination as necessary to fit the composition; selfie identity takes precedence over dramatic expression. Blend the transferred FACE, EARS, JAW, NECK and visible upper skin seamlessly: consistent skin colour, brightness, texture and shadow direction under the SAME stadium floodlights, with no face-mask seam, different neck colour, pasted-on edge or mismatched tan. Preserve the master's physical pose and surrounding players without replacing their identities; never copy the selfie background. Keep the nighttime stadium; do not change to daytime. No newly invented sponsor marks, licensed logos, misleading text, captions or watermarks. One high-quality vertical photorealistic football photograph, never a collage. TEAM KIT PRIORITY: Image 1 supplies only the original pose, scene framing and positions, NOT the winning player's or teammates' team colours. The selected playing guernsey style supplied below OVERRIDES all existing clothing and branding in Image 1. Replace the entire central footballer's original guernsey with the selected team's design in each scene, including the chest, back, collar, shorts and socks where visible. For a winning-team celebration, ALL celebrating teammates must wear the same selected team colours and pattern, not the source master's black-and-white Collingwood-style strips. Preserve teammate faces and body positions while replacing their clothing. No mixed winners' uniforms, retained master-team stripes, or incorrect sponsor logos.
